name: Adjust a device setting
short_description: Find and change one named device setting, then restore its original value.
self_assessment: I can change and restore one named device setting without help.
description: Find and change one named device setting, then restore its original value. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.

builds_on.note: Reading interface labels supports navigating settings.
